newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't sets dates for Jan-June coffee sales.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't sets dates for Jan-June coffee sales.

text.p: Brazil's Industry and Commerce Ministry has set the dates for monthly coffee auctions in the first half of 1997, said an official from Banco do Brasil which holds the electronic sales.

The ministry in July this year published a program of auctions for July to December ie the first six months of the coffee year (July/June) and said that it would publish the dates of the next six sales nearer to the time.
The program for next year's sales is as follows:
There was no mention of any change to the upper limit of each auction currently at 200,000 60-kg bags, the official said.
The next sale is to be held on November 20 and Banco do Brasil is expected to be notified of the total to be included in the auction in the next few days, the official added.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
